label: Modal spine: temporal creation does not supply an earlier empty moment
summary: Research question: does creation ex nihilo independently warrant Arrival A's A3, a possible accessible history with an earlier moment free of contingent concreta followed by a contingent-populated moment? Consulted the public English translation of Aquinas, ST I q.45 a.1 ad 3 and a.2 ad 2-3 (https://www.newadvent.org/summa/1045.htm), and I q.46 a.1 ad 4-8, a.2, a.3 (https://www.newadvent.org/summa/1046.htm). These are source-search leads; no passage witness was pinned/materialized for a new stating claim, and none is registered here. Q45 distinguishes creation from change and reads 'from nothing' as denying a presupposed material source, not necessarily describing a temporal transition. Q46 says the first created things and time can begin together: a universal cause need not presuppose time as a particular agent presupposes matter and time. Thus the theological claim that the world is created ex nihilo does NOT entail that there was an earlier, physically real, concrete-empty moment. The claim about this cosmos also does NOT refute the modal possibility A3; a counterfactual history with earlier empty time would need its own warrant, including an account of time's existence when no contingent concrete thing is present. The stronger A3-prime-w says every contingent concrete individual in its witnessing history had some earlier absence, so creation at the first instant does not supply it either. This is a genuine interpretive gap, not an argument against A2 (which applies only if an earlier empty moment exists) or an objection to God's existence. Positive direction: strengthen the actual-root bridge rather than translate ex nihilo into earlier temporal nothing. The standing route uses EveryContingentGroundedAt, actual grounding well-foundedness and actual population. Aquinas I q.3 a.4 and q.44 a.1 give a source-motivated sequence from participated or distinct esse to an extrinsic source, but the corpus already shows that modal contingency -> real participation, an esse-cause -> an actually existing concrete m.grounds supporter, and actual well-foundedness remain separate OPEN steps. Q45's universal creator is assumed from q.44, so it cannot independently close those earlier steps without circularity. This search changes no theorem, premise closure, or source claim.
blocker: A3's possibility of an earlier moment free of contingent concreta and the actual contingency-to-received-esse/actual concrete grounding bridges remain OPEN. Q45 a.1 ad 3 allows TWO readings of 'from nothing', including an order after nonexistence and the denial of a preexisting material source; our finding concerns the failure of a physical earlier-empty-moment ENTAILMENT, not denial of the first reading. Two exact next controls: (1) a first-instant created world with time starting at t0, a contingent x already present at t0, no subsequently originated contingent, and accessible histories likewise either unpopulated or populated from their first moment: this can represent ontological dependence while both A3 and A3-prime-w fail; the accessible histories must be specified to support that modal result. (2) An ontically existing necessary source g with ExistsAt true but IsAt false at every physical moment, grounding a later-born contingent x. In that structural surrogate the SAME supplied grounds relation is used for EveryContingentGroundedAt and A2ab; the first intends an actual ontic supporter while the latter intends a proximate ground of coming-to-be, so equating their physical applications is another OPEN sense bridge. Formally EveryContingentGroundedAt can hold while A2ab (which requires the ground to be temporally present at s or later) and A2 both fail. Control (2) exposes the needed source-existence-to-temporal-presence bridge; it does not certify the metaphysical possibility of a prior empty interval or refute A2. Compare exact actual-root and temporal-route premise bundles. Before historical attribution, pin/materialize q.45/q.46 and inspect Latin and translation in context. Folded from draft PR #1490 on 2026-11-13. Since then attempt c94eed5b (disambiguation 88a8fba7, CAUSE_OF_BEING originating vs sustaining) gives A2ab two derivations that widen its grounds relation to sustainers or originators; it does not relate that relation to the actual ontic supporter of EveryContingentGroundedAt, so the sense bridge named in control (2) stays OPEN.
